# Incident review: <short name>

Blameless. We describe what the system and the people did, and why it made sense at the time. We do not name a cause of failure in a person.

- Severity: SEV<1-3>
- Commander / operations / comms / scribe: <roles, not blame>
- Declared at: <time>  Mitigated at: <time>  Resolved at: <time>
- Customer impact (a person decides this sentence): <who, how many, how long>

## Timeline

One line per event, minutes from declaration (`+0 declare ...`). Mark the first mitigation, every status update, and every decision.

## What went well

<Things to keep doing: a fast rollback, a clear handoff, an update sent on time.>

## Contributing factors

<Several, not one. Include the defenses that did not fire. Ask "how did this make sense?" before "who?".>

## Where we were lucky

<What could have made this worse and did not.>

## Decisions we would make sooner

<Each: the decision, when it was made, when the information to make it first existed.>

## Action items

Each has one owner and a due date. The incident cannot move to REVIEWED while any item is open.

| Action | Owner | Due | Done |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <change> | <name> | <date> | no |
